title: Avatars in Control Slots
description: Avatars inside controls: a Button with an Avatar in a box ButtonSlot before its label, a round account button whose only content is an Avatar, and NavLink rows where a two-row box NavSlot holds the Avatar beside a label and a description. The slot sets the size of each Avatar, and the avatars stay out of the accessible names. Use it when an avatar belongs to a button, a link, or another control, instead of standing in the page.
